source: synthetic GCP demo; no real GCP resources

checks.title: VPC firewall rules should not allow unrestricted SSH ingress
checks.explanation: Checks one enabled ingress rule for world-open TCP access covering port 22. Higher-priority deny rules, hierarchical and network firewall policies, and instance external IPs are not evaluated.
checks.remediation: Restrict sourceRanges to trusted networks (for example the IAP TCP forwarding range 35.235.240.0/20) or delete the rule after reviewing legitimate access requirements.
